comparator.sourceNotes: The broad Linguistics route closes 60+60+60. Language X is instantiated as Czech 1-4, the first complete documented eligible sequence after an empty Catalan allocation, with sequential prerequisites and English instruction. Czech is not added as an instruction language. Specialization Linguistics remains one 6-EC unit rather than invented formal tracks; 30 EC of genuine profiling remains open. Academic Literacy Test and recurring tutoring are zero-credit formation.
